g.text: browser — one document, island never unloads
main.js — the import root (TestIslandModulesMatchImportClosure: EVERY island/app module is in its closure)
call plane: calls.js · ice.js · connection.js — NEVER import each other (acyclicity enforced by arch_test)
state.js + auth.js — the neutral substrate everything MAY import
panels.js · transcribe.js · dialgate.js · postcall.js · typeahead.js · latency.js · notify.js · i18n.js · ui.js · shortcuts.js · session.js · csrf.js · config.js · selftest.js
shell.js (classic script, OUTSIDE the closure) — tab→island affordances: data-dial · live-call badge · live-context slot · agent pill · command palette · morph focus move
custom events: wp:calls-changed (ice syncs without importing calls) · wp:session-opened · wp:drafts-changed
/config.js — window.PBX_CONFIG: sipDomain · websocketPath · iceServers · phoneApi · contacts · crm (+asr · dialCooldownSeconds · metrics · agent ONLY when on)
/api/* — session · csrf · calls (+note/review/summary-draft) · transcribe · transcripts · contacts · dials · push-devices · metrics/latency · auth/webauthn (session-gated, CSRF)
/hooks/* — message · fax · status · ring (Bearer secret, machine-facing, never browser)
/login + /enroll (standalone assets dirs: login-page.js · webauthn.js — outside the island closure)
reads DOM state only (works when island scripts fail)
recordCrmCall · notes autosave · dial-gate ask · latency beacons
